d:
Short, messy, sea-foam green hair with jagged fringes. Glowing, pale yellow eyes with a wide, manic stare. Appears as a mature, undead humanoid with a gaunt, weathered face. Lean, athletic build with greyish, pallid skin. Wearing a tattered, dark navy blue captain's coat over a salt-stained grey shirt and dark trousers. Possesses a single, large, curved horn-like protrusion on the forehead, a rusted harpoon as a weapon, and a long, thick, scaly fish-like tail in a muted teal shade.
BODY COLOR: pallid grey
